summary: Iteration 5: Verified NEW 'why' Site Image slot end-to-end. Backend: added 3 new tests (why-seeded default, why-replace + restore, GET returns hero+why+gallery) — all 29 tests pass (11 quote/admin + 18 site-images including new why tests). Backend correctly (a) seeds/ensures a single active 'why' doc pointing to the Weekend Plans customer-assets URL, (b) upload endpoint accepts section='why' with hero-like soft-delete-previous behavior, (c) rejects invalid section with 400, (d) requires X-Admin-Password (401 without). Frontend: Landing renders data-testid why-image with the branded Weekend Plans image (naturalWidth=1289), hero-image and gallery-item-0..3 still render. Admin /admin login (tidyups2026) works, wrong password shows toast + stays on login; Site Images tab shows hero-manager, why-manager (with why-replace-btn + hidden why-upload-input), and gallery-manager with drag-reorder grid. DB baseline restored: 1 hero (Our Fleet) + 1 why (Why Tidyups → Weekend Plans URL) + 4 gallery in original order.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to grow (~330 lines) mixing storage, models, routes, and SMS — should be split into modules (storage.py, routes/site_images.py, routes/quotes.py) before adding more sections.

seed_site_images's ensure-why branch is idempotent, but if an admin uploads a why image and then soft-deletes it, the next server startup will re-add the seed 'Why Tidyups' Weekend Plans URL. This is intended per the iteration note but could confuse admins expecting a truly empty why slot — consider surfacing this behavior in an admin tooltip.
Upload endpoint duplicates hero/why replace logic — a small refactor (single 'section is singleton?' check) would keep future singleton sections DRY.
DELETE /api/site-images/{id} still only soft-deletes; underlying storage blobs remain orphaned in Emergent object storage. Add periodic cleanup or hard-delete via storage API.
put_object / get_object are synchronous `requests` calls inside async endpoints — blocks the event loop on large uploads. Consider fastapi.concurrency.run_in_threadpool or an async HTTP client.
resolveImageUrl on the frontend only handles urls that startsWith('http'); protocol-relative or blob: URLs would be wrongly prefixed. Minor edge case only.
test_credentials: Admin password: tidyups2026 (verified). Object storage uses backend EMERGENT_LLM_KEY server-side (REAL, not mocked).
seed_data_creation: Test run created 1 additional TEST_ImgIter Regression lead (quotes collection has no delete endpoint — 12 TEST_ leads have accumulated across iterations 1-5, matches prior context). All test-uploaded site images (1 hero + 1 why + 1 gallery) were deleted; original hero and why docs were restored via direct pymongo un-soft-delete. Final DB state: 1 hero (Our Fleet) + 1 why (Why Tidyups → Weekend Plans URL) + 4 gallery (Serving Edmonton, Home & Office Service, Our Team, On The Road, orders 0-3).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://expo-book-cleaning.preview.emergentagent.com. Test files: /app/backend/tests/test_site_images.py (18 tests incl. new TestWhyReplace + TestGetSiteImages::test_why_section_seeded) and /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (11 tests). All 29 pass under pytest+xdist in ~5s. When testing 'why' or 'hero' replace, the endpoint soft-deletes the prior active doc — to restore the seeded doc, use pymongo directly (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from env with local fallback) and $set is_deleted=False on the original id, since the API has no un-soft-delete route. Note: seed_site_images() auto-ensures a 'why' doc if none is active on startup, so if you forget to restore, the next backend restart will re-seed a fresh Why Tidyups doc (with a new id).
rca of the issue: N/A — new feature (why section) verified working end-to-end. No bugs found.
